name: BVH for Gaussian Surfels
aliases: Indirect illumination via BVH ray tracing
definition: A method to compute global illumination for each Gaussian vertex by ray tracing through a learned radiance field represented by Gaussians, enforcing physical constraints unlike unconstrained SH-based methods.
summary: BVH for Gaussian Surfels accelerates physically-based indirect illumination for Gaussian splatting by organizing ellipsoidal surfels into a hierarchy for ray tracing, unlike standard rasterization.
